rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 高市内閣の発足, dated 21 October 2025 as captured that night, says that after a meeting of the coalition party leaders at the Prime Minister's Office and the announcement of the list of ministers by the new Chief Cabinet Secretary (木原稔), the Prime Minister's Imperial appointment ceremony and the ministers' attestation ceremony took place at the Imperial Palace; its photo captions show 高市総理 entering the Office and at the press conference.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account states that the Takaichi cabinet (高市内閣) was launched on 21 October 2025.
